source_metadata.title: Association Between the Sequence of β-Lactam and Vancomycin Administration and Mortality in Patients With Suspected Sepsis
source_metadata.authors: Yutaka Kondo; Michael Klompas; Caroline S. McKenna; Theodore R. Pak; Claire N. Shappell; Laura DelloStritto; Chanu Rhee
source_metadata.source_note: The article references online supplementary material, but no companion PDF was listed or supplied for this task.

extraction_limitations: ATOM extraction is grounded in the primary main-text PDF only; online supplementary tables/figure were referenced by the article but were not listed as companion materials for this task.

The current LiteratureAtom schema cannot encode all arm-specific dispersion statistics in a single quantitative result; key IQR values were preserved in source-specific atoms and original_result_text where applicable.
Table 1 reports the creatinine unit as mg/L in the source; this was not silently corrected because the workflow requires preserving source-reported content.
